title: Sengoku Rance: Before the Battle
alt: At sunrise a man in green armor and a white cape stands on a grassy hill with his back to the viewer and holds up a dark sword. A woman with pink hair stands beside him, and clay creatures lift their arms in the grass. The sun rises behind a snow mountain, and a Japanese castle stands among cherry trees above two armies on a plain.
summary: A painting of a scene from Sengoku Rance in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is dawn in JAPAN, the country of Sengoku Rance, on the morning of a battle. Sengoku Rance is a game by AliceSoft. Rance holds up the sword Chaos, and Sill stands next to him.
The sun rises behind a snow mountain. Four Hannies cheer in the grass. Two armies stand on the plain below a castle with cherry trees. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
